```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```



```{r}
# Individual Surrogate Figure - Example Data

indivsurrogate <- data.frame(
  Participant = c('alpha', 'alpha','beta', 'beta','gamma', 'gamma', 'delta', 'delta'),
  Surrogate = c(1, 1.5,1, 1.5,2, 2.5, 1.75, 2.25),
  Endpoint = c(1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 1.25, 1.75, 2, 2.5),
  Treatment = c('Unvaccinated', 'Vaccinated','Unvaccinated', 'Vaccinated', 'Unvaccinated', 'Vaccinated', 'Unvaccinated', 'Vaccinated')
)

  
```



```{r}
# Plotting Individual-Level Surrogate Figure

ggplot(
  data = indivsurrogate,
  aes(
    x = Surrogate,
    y = Endpoint,
    shape = Treatment,
    color = Participant
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 6) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Participant), linetype = "dashed") +

  # Colorblind-friendly colors
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    alpha = "#0072B2",  # blue
    beta  = "#D55E00",  # vermillion
    gamma = "#009E73",  # green
    delta = "#CC79A7"   # purple
  )) +

  # Larger fonts
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Surrogate Marker",
    y = "Clinical Endpoint",
    color = "Participant",
    shape = "Treatment"
  )
```




```{r}
# Trial Surrogate Figure - Example Data

trialsurrogate <- data.frame(
  Participant = c('alpha', 'beta','gamma', 'delta','beta', 'gamma', 'alpha', 'delta'),
  Surrogate = c(1, 1 ,1.5, 1.5,2, 2, 2.5, 2.5),
  Endpoint = c(1, 1.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 2, 2.5),
  Treatment = c('Unvaccinated', 'Unvaccinated','Unvaccinated', 'Unvaccinated', 'Vaccinated', 'Vaccinated', 'Vaccinated', 'Vaccinated')
)

```


```{r}

ggplot(
  data = trialsurrogate,
  aes(
    x = Surrogate,
    y = Endpoint,
    shape = Treatment,
    color = Participant
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 6) +

    alpha = "#0072B2",  # blue

    delta = "#CC79A7"   # purple
  )) +

  # Larger fonts
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Surrogate Marker",

    shape = "Treatment"
  )
```
